candidates.title: How MoEngage built agentic customer engagement on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
candidates.summary: MoEngage built Merlin AI, a set of AI agents on Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that let marketing and product teams draft, analyze, and adjust campaigns from a single conversation. Learn how MoEngage turned its existing APIs into MCP tools and kept each tenant's data isolated while giving agents secure access to live platform data.

candidates.title: Astra for Law leads in legal intelligence
candidates.summary: Astra for Law ranked first in a launch evaluation spanning 24 areas of law. Every ChatGPT Enterprise customer can now request access.

candidates.title: How Duco transforms financial data automation with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
candidates.summary: Duco, a data automation platform for tier-one banks, rebuilt its agentic AI stack on Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. With strict per-tenant isolation, a multi-model strategy, and an MCP skills architecture that cut context overhead by 90%, Duco cut reconciliation deployment time 10x and onboarding costs 70%.
